question: Does the methodology choose better which biological information to use for predicting enzyme activity?

positive_control.what_this_proves: when a sparse subset really carries the signal, this harness finds most of it and selection beats using everything. A null on real data is therefore about the data, not the instrument.

what_this_is_not.a_shap_value_is_not_evidence_of_value: it is an attribution inside one fitted model. Two collinear probes split one signal and both look weak; a feature the model leaned on can be useless out of sample. SHAP proposes an ordering here and never settles a claim.
what_this_is_not.the_curve_is_not_a_validated_panel_size: the k at the curve's best point was chosen with hindsight across the whole grid. The validated size is the one the inner folds chose, reported separately, and the two often differ.
what_this_is_not.beating_a_selector_is_not_predicting_pha: every endpoint here is an in-vitro activity or a functional screen score. Nothing in this module touches a clearance, an AUC or a concentration.
what_this_is_not.a_selector_cannot_abstain_by_accident: hand any of these pure noise and it returns the k luckiest columns. That is why the permuted-outcome control is run beside every real result rather than on request.
what_this_is_not.agreement_between_selectors_is_not_truth: two selectors can agree because they share a bias. Agreement is reported as a stability diagnostic, never as confirmation.

match_quality_first_three_draws.matched_on: mean and log variance; redundancy is REPORTED not matched
match_quality_first_three_draws.why_redundancy_is_only_reported: a mechanistic pool is correlated because its members are co-regulated, which is part of what makes it a mechanism. Forcing a random pool to the same internal correlation would smuggle in a piece of the structure the comparison is meant to test. It is measured on both sides so a reader can see whether the pools differ in it.

matched_random_pools.what_this_isolates: the pool size, the probes' expression level and their spread are held fixed; only the biology used to choose them differs. A mechanistic pool that does not beat matched chance has reduced dimension, not applied knowledge.

S8_vs_S4.how_to_read: NON_INFERIOR means the candidate cannot be worse by more than 5% of the incumbent's loss. UNDECIDED means the design lacks the power to say that, which is not the same claim and must not be reported as one.

S8_vs_S1_whole_array.how_to_read: NON_INFERIOR means the candidate cannot be worse by more than 5% of the incumbent's loss. UNDECIDED means the design lacks the power to say that, which is not the same claim and must not be reported as one.

non_inferiority.why_a_second_test: a non-significant difference is not equivalence. Concluding that the simple pipeline suffices requires excluding the possibility that it is worse by an amount that matters, which is a statement about the LOWER bound against minus the margin and a different test from the superiority ladder.

S1_univariate_outcome.what_this_isolates: the loss of S1_univariate_outcome with the whole_array block minus the same arm without it, on identical rows and identical folds. Nothing else differs between the two fits.

S2_residual_on_baseline.what_this_isolates: the loss of S2_residual_on_baseline with the whole_array block minus the same arm without it, on identical rows and identical folds. Nothing else differs between the two fits.

S8_pool_then_univariate.what_this_isolates: the loss of S8_pool_then_univariate with the whole_array block minus the same arm without it, on identical rows and identical folds. Nothing else differs between the two fits.
